market.domesticSlice: Salzer Electronics Ltd (listed): Wires & Cables is its 2nd-largest segment at ~39.5% of FY24 revenue mix (enamelled wires, tinned copper wire, flexible bus bars), with Q3 FY26 total revenue ₹424 Cr (+24% YoY). structureFacts: Demand drivers: power transmission, consumer electronics, EV/automotive electrification, renewable energy, rural electrification (motor/transformer coil demand)
Copper price volatility (LME-linked) is a structural margin risk across the segment
Test standard IS 8783:1995 applies to submersible winding wire

adoptionStructure.note: Motor/pump OEM approval processes, insulation-grade compliance (IS/IEC/NEMA standards), price tightly linked to LME copper pass-through, quality consistency (avoiding winding failures in submersible motors), and increasingly performance differentiation (motor efficiency gains) drive purchasing.
